stations.title: The cupboard
stations.text: Today Gethin edits a file by hand.

captions: Ffion played request 43 last night, and Gethin wants it off the list.
Every request the station sends only reads, so Gethin edits a file in the cupboard.
You write requests with a method and headers that say who is asking.
The studio asks to remove request 43 with its key, and it comes off the list.
A method says what to do, headers say who asks. No more cupboard edits.
